cards.title: &&, || and !
cards.body: `&&` (and) is true only when both sides are. `||` (or) is true when at least one side is. `!` flips true and false.

hi.title: &&, || aur !
hi.body: `&&` (and) tabhi true hai jab dono side true hon. `||` (or) true hai jab kam se kam ek side true ho. `!` true aur false ko palat deta hai.

cards.title: Strictest check first
cards.body: With `else if`, the first true condition wins, so put the strictest check first or a broader one will catch it.

hi.title: Sabse sakht check pehle
hi.body: `else if` ke saath pehli true condition jeet jaati hai, isliye sabse sakht check pehle rakho, warna koi badi condition use pakad legi.

cards.title: Spot the bug
cards.body: Only adult members get in free, but a 25-year-old who is not a member does too. Which line is wrong?

bug.fix: `||` needs just one side to be true. Both must be true here, so use `&&`.

hi.title: Bug dhoondo
hi.body: Sirf adult members free mein andar aate hain, par 25 saal ka non-member bhi aa jaata hai. Kaunsi line galat hai?
hi.fix: `||` ko sirf ek side true chahiye. Yahan dono true honi chahiye, isliye `&&` use karo.

check.question: What does this print?
check.explanation: `n > 5` is true, but 10 is even, so `n % 2 === 1` is false, and `&&` needs both.

hi.question: Yeh kya print karega?
hi.explanation: `n > 5` true hai, par 10 even hai, isliye `n % 2 === 1` false hai, aur `&&` ko dono chahiye.

exercise.prompt: Read a whole number. Print `FizzBuzz` if it divides by both 3 and 5, `Fizz` if only by 3, `Buzz` if only by 5, and the number itself otherwise.
exercise.promptHi: Ek whole number padho. Agar woh 3 aur 5 dono se divide hota hai toh `FizzBuzz`, sirf 3 se toh `Fizz`, sirf 5 se toh `Buzz`, warna number khud print karo.
